levels.name: Sharp
levels.tagline: counts the dice aimed at it

help.goal: Walk all of your tokens out of your corner, once round the board and up your own colour's lane into the middle. First one home wins.
steps: A 6 frees a token from your corner onto your start square.
Tap a lit token — or one of the buttons under the board — to walk it.
Land on a lone enemy token and it goes back to its corner.
Roll a 6 and you throw again, up to three times.
You need the exact number to step into the middle.
notes: The eight starred squares are safe: nobody is ever sent home from one.
Two of your tokens on one square make a block — no enemy may land there.
Three sixes in a row and the turn is lost, so the third one is never free.
If the roll has nothing to play, the turn passes on its own and says why.
Quick uses 2 tokens each and Classic 4; play alone and bots take the other corners.
